title: Interpretation 11-05 (City of Tacoma): Group E sprinkler threshold and a church and day care sharing one fire area (IBC 903.2.3)
jurisdiction: Washington State, requested by City of Tacoma (comparative test only; not Alberta)
code_edition: 2009 International Building Code, Section 903.2.3 with Washington State amendment, as cited

facts.text: Document type: State Building Code Council interpretation no. 11-05, one page; requester City of Tacoma.
Question 1: whether the removal of 'fire areas' from the state amendment to Section 903.2.3 was intentional.

Scenario asked about: a church with an occupant load of 100 and a day care with an occupant load of 25 in the same fire area (occupant load 125), with no sprinkler system or fire barrier between them.
The amendment's Exception 2 (as quoted) exempts Group E occupancies with an occupant load of 50 or less.
